name: Initial-grasp pose quality view v1
label_definition: Earliest eligible completed GRASP_HANDLE event before source opening exceeds 10%, with source stable-grasp flags and measured gripper closure; exclude events after prior major opening in the primary view.
label_confidence: Source phase/closure/flag heuristic only. Source grasp flags do not establish physical bilateral force, retention, native replay success or firm-grasp ground truth.
scope: Additional Train and Val label-quality views only. Original raw data, indices, Val inventory and validation sources remain unchanged. No training or policy evaluation.
